'''Rotation modules''' were internal components incorporated into [[grenade mortar]]s such as the [[MM-s3 grenade launcher]]. The rotation module stabilized [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] as they were launched from the mortar, giving them an optimum range of five hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="EGWT" />
